The single-I_clk I2C + MCLK ODDR combination completed TD/STA/Bitgen on seeds 1 and 3. Both runs removed PHY-5060/5079 but retained PHY-5016 x4 and PHY-5088 x1; detailed analysis ties PHY-5088 to the DDR PHY AL_PHY_SCLK -> AL_PHY_PLL -> DDR PLL clkc[0] cascade. Official UG1310 confirms MLCLK is a supported IOCLK input source, but TD prints no unique DRC sink/pad and this does not resolve the warning; it remains open.
